stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
stem.zh: 查看患者病历并回答案例题。

title.en: Unfolding case: hyperactive delirium with urinary tract infection
title.zh: 展开案例：尿路感染伴活动过度型谵妄

summary.en: An 82-year-old woman with mild Alzheimer-type dementia has an abrupt 36-hour change from baseline, including visual hallucinations, agitation, poor intake, new urinary incontinence, and failure to recognize her daughter. The daughter states this is not her usual dementia pattern.
summary.zh: 一名82岁女性有轻度阿尔茨海默型痴呆，36小时内突然偏离基线，出现视幻觉、躁动、进食差、新发尿失禁，并认不出女儿。女儿说明这并不是她平时的痴呆表现。

content.en: Lives in assisted living. Baseline: oriented to person and place, manages meals and grooming with cueing, converses coherently with occasional word-finding pauses, sleeps through the night. History: mild Alzheimer-type dementia, hypertension, osteoarthritis, type 2 diabetes managed with metformin, remote hip fracture repair. Allergy: sulfonamides (rash). Home medications: lisinopril 10 mg daily, acetaminophen 650 mg every 6 hr PRN joint pain, metformin 500 mg twice daily, multivitamin daily. No indwelling urinary catheter, no recent hospitalization, no reported fall or head trauma, no new medications, no alcohol use.
content.zh: 住在协助生活机构。基线：能定向到本人和地点，在提示下能自行进餐和梳洗，交谈连贯但偶有找词困难，夜间可整夜睡眠。病史：轻度阿尔茨海默型痴呆、高血压、骨关节炎、二型糖尿病（服用二甲双胍）、三年前髋部骨折修复。过敏：磺胺类药物（皮疹）。家庭用药：赖诺普利10 mg每日一次、对乙酰氨基酚650 mg每6小时按需用于关节痛、二甲双胍500 mg每日两次、每日复合维生素。无留置导尿管，近期未住院，未报告跌倒或头部外伤，无新增用药，无饮酒。

title.en: Emergency department assessment and initial data

content.en: Daughter reports: over 36 hr the client became "a completely different person," talked to people who were not there, tried to climb over the bed rail, slept only in brief agitated bursts, refused breakfast, pulled out her hearing aid, and was incontinent of urine twice overnight. Vital signs: T 100.9 °F (38.3 °C) oral, HR 104/min, BP 148/82 mm Hg, RR 20/min, SpO₂ 96% room air. Exam: restless, pulling at gown and blood-pressure cuff, inconsistent command following, oriented to person only, dry mucous membranes, decreased skin turgor, mild suprapubic tenderness, no costovertebral-angle tenderness, no focal motor deficit. Straight catheter specimen: 60 mL cloudy malodorous urine. Labs: WBC 14.2 ×10³/µL with 82% neutrophils and 6% bands; Hgb 11.8 g/dL; platelets 210 ×10³/µL; Na 146 mEq/L; K 4.0 mEq/L; Cl 108 mEq/L; HCO₃ 24 mEq/L; BUN 32 mg/dL; creatinine 1.3 mg/dL (baseline 0.9); glucose 158 mg/dL; lactate 1.6 mmol/L. Urinalysis: amber, cloudy, specific gravity 1.028, positive leukocyte esterase, positive nitrites, large bacteria, 50-100 WBC/hpf, trace protein. Blood cultures and urine culture sent. Head CT: no acute intracranial pathology.
content.zh: 女儿报告：过去36小时患者“像变了一个人”，对不存在的人说话，试图翻越床栏，只能短暂而躁动地睡眠，拒绝早餐，拔掉助听器，夜间两次尿失禁。生命体征：口温100.9 °F (38.3 °C)，心率104次/分，血压148/82 mm Hg，呼吸20次/分，室内空气SpO₂ 96%。查体：躁动，拉扯病号服和血压袖带，不能稳定执行指令，仅能定向到本人，口黏膜干燥，皮肤弹性下降，耻骨上轻压痛，无肋脊角叩痛，无局灶性运动缺损。一次性直导尿标本：60 mL浑浊且有异味尿液。实验室：白细胞14.2 ×10³/µL，中性粒82%，杆状核6%；血红蛋白11.8 g/dL；血小板210 ×10³/µL；钠146 mEq/L；钾4.0 mEq/L；氯108 mEq/L；碳酸氢根24 mEq/L；BUN 32 mg/dL；肌酐1.3 mg/dL（基线0.9）；血糖158 mg/dL；乳酸1.6 mmol/L。尿检：琥珀色、浑浊，比重1.028，白细胞酯酶阳性，亚硝酸盐阳性，大量细菌，白细胞50-100/高倍视野，微量蛋白。已送血培养和尿培养。头颅CT：无急性颅内病变。

content.en: Orders: ceftriaxone 1 g IV every 24 hr; 0.9% sodium chloride 500 mL IV over 2 hr; maintenance IV fluids at 75 mL/hr. The sulfonamide allergy is documented so sulfonamide antibiotics are avoided. During transport the client attempts to stand on the stretcher, swings at the transporter, and shouts, "Get away from me!" Nursing actions: lights dimmed, calm low voice used, gentle reorientation provided, bed placed in lowest position, call light within reach, daughter invited to remain as a familiar presence, hearing aid cleaned and replaced. CAM screen: acute onset yes; inattention yes; disorganized thinking yes; altered level of consciousness yes with fluctuation between hyperalert agitation and brief drowsiness. CAM positive; provider notified. Hour 3: T 100.6 °F (38.1 °C), HR 98/min, BP 140/78 mm Hg, RR 18/min, SpO₂ 97%. Urine output: 40 mL in 2 hr, dark amber. Takes only a few sips of water.
content.zh: 医嘱：头孢曲松1 g静脉给药，每24小时一次；0.9%氯化钠500 mL静脉输注2小时；维持静脉液75 mL/小时。已记录磺胺类过敏，因此避免使用磺胺类抗生素。转运途中患者试图从担架上站起，挥手打转运人员，并喊“离我远点！”护理措施：调暗灯光，用低而平静的声音交流，温和再定向，床置最低位，呼叫铃置于可及处，邀请女儿留在床旁作为熟悉陪伴，清洁并重新戴上助听器。CAM筛查：急性起病——是；注意力不集中——是；思维紊乱——是；意识水平改变——是，在高度警觉躁动和短暂嗜睡之间波动。CAM阳性，已通知医务人员。第3小时：体温100.6 °F (38.1 °C)，心率98次/分，血压140/78 mm Hg，呼吸18次/分，SpO₂ 97%。尿量：2小时40 mL，深琥珀色。仅饮少量水。

title.en: Response to fluids and ongoing delirium risk
title.zh: 补液反应与持续谵妄风险

content.en: IV bolus complete. Hour 10 vitals: T 99.7 °F (37.6 °C), HR 92/min, BP 134/76 mm Hg, RR 16/min, SpO₂ 98%. Less combative but still confused; intermittently recognizes daughter, misidentifies room and time, repeatedly picks at IV site, has dislodged saline lock once, sleeps in 20-minute stretches, then wakes and calls out. Daughter has been at bedside for 10 hr and is exhausted and tearful. Hour 12 labs: WBC 12.8 ×10³/µL; Na 143 mEq/L; BUN 28 mg/dL; creatinine 1.1 mg/dL; glucose 142 mg/dL. Urine output over past 4 hr: 160 mL, light yellow. Preliminary urine culture: >100,000 CFU/mL Escherichia coli; susceptibilities pending. Braden Scale score 14; high fall-risk score; no meal intake since admission. Bed alarm active.
content.zh: 静脉补液已完成。第10小时生命体征：体温99.7 °F (37.6 °C)，心率92次/分，血压134/76 mm Hg，呼吸16次/分，SpO₂ 98%。攻击性减轻但仍意识混乱；间断能认出女儿，仍认错房间和时间，反复抠抓静脉部位，曾一次弄脱盐水锁，睡眠每次约20分钟后惊醒呼喊。女儿已在床旁10小时，疲惫且流泪。第12小时实验室：白细胞12.8 ×10³/µL；钠143 mEq/L；BUN 28 mg/dL；肌酐1.1 mg/dL；血糖142 mg/dL。过去4小时尿量160 mL，淡黄色。尿培养初报：大肠埃希菌>100,000 CFU/mL，药敏待回报。Braden评分14分；跌倒风险高；入院后未进正餐。床报警器已启用。

title.en: PRN severe-agitation order and facility safety checks
title.zh: 严重躁动按需医嘱与机构安全核查

content.en: Provider order: haloperidol 0.5 mg PO every 6 hr PRN severe agitation that creates imminent risk of self-harm or harm to others; if the client cannot safely take oral medication, contact the provider for an IM route order. Use only if non-pharmacologic measures fail. Facility protocol before first dose when feasible: verify recent ECG/QTc or obtain ECG per protocol; review potassium and magnesium status and other QT-prolonging medications; screen for Parkinson disease or dementia with Lewy bodies; document the safety threat and failed non-pharmacologic measures. After dose: reassess agitation and level of sedation within 30-60 min; monitor for hypotension, extrapyramidal symptoms, and oversedation; continue least-restrictive delirium care.
content.zh: 医嘱：氟哌啶醇0.5 mg口服，每6小时按需，用于造成患者自身或他人即刻伤害风险的严重躁动；如果患者不能安全口服，需联系医务人员改开肌内给药途径。仅在非药物措施无效后使用。机构首次给药前安全流程（可行时）：确认近期心电图/QTc或按流程做心电图；查看钾、镁状态及其他延长QT的药物；筛查帕金森病或路易体痴呆；记录安全威胁以及已尝试但无效的非药物措施。给药后：30-60分钟内复评躁动和镇静程度；监测低血压、锥体外系反应和过度镇静；继续采用限制性最小的谵妄护理。

content.en: Overnight the provider issued an IM route order, and the client received one IM dose of haloperidol after repeated non-pharmacologic measures failed and she climbed over the side rail despite the bed alarm. ECG/QTc and electrolyte review met facility parameters before administration. She calmed within 30 min and slept for 3 hr. Morning assessment: T 98.8 °F (37.1 °C), HR 82/min, BP 130/72 mm Hg, RR 14/min, SpO₂ 98%. Drowsy but arousable; follows one-step commands; recognizes daughter by name; still believes she is at home and gives the year as "the nineties." Ate half of a soft breakfast with cueing. Urine output past 8 hr: 320 mL, pale yellow. Repeat labs: WBC 10.4 ×10³/µL; Na 140 mEq/L; BUN 24 mg/dL; creatinine 1.0 mg/dL; glucose 130 mg/dL. Final urine culture: E. coli sensitive to ceftriaxone. Repeat CAM remains positive but improved: inattention persists but is less severe; answers are relevant but slow; mildly drowsy without prior hyperalert-somnolent fluctuation. Provider plans transition to oral cephalexin when full-meal tolerance is demonstrated; target discharge back to assisted living in 48-72 hr if delirium continues to clear. Daughter asks, "She's better but still not herself — when will she be back to normal?"
content.zh: 夜间，医务人员开具肌内给药途径医嘱；在多次非药物措施无效且患者虽有床报警仍翻越床栏后，给予一次肌内氟哌啶醇。给药前心电图/QTc和电解质复核符合机构参数。30分钟内安静下来，并睡了3小时。晨间评估：体温98.8 °F (37.1 °C)，心率82次/分，血压130/72 mm Hg，呼吸14次/分，SpO₂ 98%。嗜睡但可唤醒；能执行一步指令；能叫出女儿名字；仍认为自己在家，并说年份是“九十年代”。在提示下吃了半份软食早餐。过去8小时尿量320 mL，淡黄色。复查实验室：白细胞10.4 ×10³/µL；钠140 mEq/L；BUN 24 mg/dL；肌酐1.0 mg/dL；血糖130 mg/dL。尿培养最终结果：大肠埃希菌，对头孢曲松敏感。复查CAM仍阳性但改善：注意力不集中仍存在但减轻；回答相关但缓慢；轻度嗜睡，不再出现之前高度警觉和嗜睡之间的波动。医务人员计划在患者能耐受完整一餐后转为口服头孢氨苄；若谵妄继续缓解，目标48-72小时后回协助生活机构。女儿问：“她好多了，但还不像自己——什么时候才能恢复正常？”

stem.en: Stage 1: For each cue, identify whether it most strongly supports acute delirium from an infection/dehydration process or the client's known baseline dementia.
stem.zh: 阶段1：对每个线索，判断其最能支持感染/脱水过程导致的急性谵妄，还是患者已知的基线痴呆。

rows.en: Abrupt change over 36 hr from usual cognition and behavior
rows.zh: 36小时内认知和行为突然偏离平时状态

rows.en: CAM positive with inattention, disorganized thinking, and fluctuating level of consciousness
rows.zh: CAM阳性，伴注意力不集中、思维紊乱和意识水平波动

rows.en: Baseline word-finding pauses with orientation to person and place
rows.zh: 基线表现为偶有找词困难，但能定向到本人和地点

rows.en: Fever, leukocytosis with bands, suprapubic tenderness, and nitrite-positive pyuric urine
rows.zh: 发热、白细胞升高伴杆状核、耻骨上压痛以及亚硝酸盐阳性且脓尿

rows.en: Mild Alzheimer-type dementia documented 6 months ago
rows.zh: 6个月前记录有轻度阿尔茨海默型痴呆

correct.en: The acute 36-hour change, fluctuating attention and consciousness, positive CAM, fever, inflammatory markers, suprapubic tenderness, and abnormal urinalysis support delirium triggered by symptomatic infection and dehydration. Her documented mild Alzheimer-type dementia explains chronic baseline memory and word-finding limitations but does not explain the abrupt febrile fluctuating presentation.
correct.zh: 36小时内急性改变、注意力和意识水平波动、CAM阳性、发热、炎症指标、耻骨上压痛和异常尿检，支持由有症状感染和脱水诱发的谵妄。既往记录的轻度阿尔茨海默型痴呆可解释慢性的记忆和找词困难，但不能解释这种突然、发热且波动的表现。

byChoice.en: A rapid change over hours to days is a classic delirium cue, especially when the daughter can describe a clear baseline.
byChoice.zh: 数小时到数天内快速改变是谵妄典型线索，尤其当女儿能清楚描述患者基线时。

byChoice.en: CAM findings of inattention and fluctuating consciousness point to delirium rather than a slow dementia trajectory.
byChoice.zh: CAM提示注意力不集中和意识波动，更符合谵妄，而不是缓慢进展的痴呆。

byChoice.en: Occasional word-finding difficulty with preserved person/place orientation is the client's stated baseline and should not be mistaken for the acute problem.
byChoice.zh: 偶有找词困难且仍能定向到本人和地点，是患者原有基线，不应误认为此次急性问题。

byChoice.en: Systemic and urinary findings identify a reversible precipitant for delirium rather than isolated chronic cognitive decline.
byChoice.zh: 全身感染和泌尿系统线索指出谵妄的可逆诱因，而不是单纯慢性认知下降。

byChoice.en: A known dementia diagnosis increases delirium risk and provides the baseline comparison; it does not by itself explain the abrupt syndrome.
byChoice.zh: 已知痴呆会增加谵妄风险，并提供基线对照；但它本身不能解释这种突然发生的综合征。

testTakingStrategy.en: When dementia is in the history, do not stop there. Compare the current presentation with baseline and look for acute fluctuation, inattention, and reversible triggers.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 病史中有痴呆时，不要就此停止判断。要把当前表现与基线比较，并寻找急性波动、注意力不集中和可逆诱因。

glossary.defZh: 患者平时稳定的认知和功能状态，用来判断是否发生急性改变。
难以维持、转移或集中注意力，是谵妄的重要表现。
尿液中白细胞增多，提示泌尿道炎症或感染可能。

questions.category: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control

stem.en: Stage 1: The client attempts to stand on the stretcher and swings at staff during transport. Which nursing action has the highest priority?
stem.zh: 阶段1：患者在转运途中试图从担架上站起，并挥手打工作人员。哪项护理措施优先级最高？

options.en: Request a benzodiazepine before attempting environmental or sensory interventions.
options.zh: 在尝试环境或感官干预之前，先要求使用苯二氮䓬类药物。

options.en: Stay with the client, lower the bed, use a calm voice, and redirect her while protecting her from falling.
options.zh: 留在患者身边，降低床位，用平静语气交流，并在防止跌倒的同时重新引导她。

options.en: Tell the daughter that the behavior is expected progression of dementia and ask her to leave so the client can rest.
options.zh: 告诉女儿这是痴呆进展的预期表现，并请她离开以便患者休息。

options.en: Apply bilateral wrist restraints immediately because the client is combative.
options.zh: 因患者有攻击性，立即使用双侧腕部约束。

correct.en: Immediate physical safety is the priority. Hyperactive delirium creates high fall and injury risk, so the nurse should remain with the client, keep the bed low, use calm de-escalation, and redirect or reorient while preserving least-restrictive care.
correct.zh: 当前优先是立即保障身体安全。活动过度型谵妄会显著增加跌倒和受伤风险，因此护士应留在患者身边，保持床位低，用平静方式降级处理，并在限制性最小的前提下重新引导或再定向。

byChoice.en: Restraints can worsen agitation and delirium and are not the first response when least-restrictive safety measures can be attempted.
byChoice.zh: 约束可能加重躁动和谵妄；在可尝试限制性更小的安全措施时，不应作为首选。

byChoice.en: Benzodiazepines can worsen delirium in older adults unless there is a specific indication such as alcohol or benzodiazepine withdrawal.
byChoice.zh: 除酒精或苯二氮䓬类戒断等特定适应证外，苯二氮䓬类可加重老年人谵妄。

byChoice.en: This addresses the immediate fall/injury threat and uses first-line non-pharmacologic delirium care.
byChoice.zh: 该措施处理当前跌倒/受伤威胁，并采用谵妄的一线非药物护理。

byChoice.en: The presentation is acute and potentially reversible, and the daughter is a valuable source of baseline information and familiar reassurance.
byChoice.zh: 这种表现是急性且可能可逆的；女儿能提供基线资料，也能作为熟悉的安抚来源。

testTakingStrategy.en: For an agitated client, choose the option that prevents immediate harm while using the least restrictive effective intervention.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 面对躁动患者，选择既能防止即刻伤害、又采用有效且限制性最小措施的选项。

glossary.defZh: 用平静沟通、减少刺激和安全陪伴来降低躁动或冲突。
在能保障安全的前提下，优先使用对患者活动和自主权限制最少的措施。
降低跌倒风险的护理措施，如床低位、报警、陪伴、非滑鞋和环境整理。

stem.en: Stage 2: The PRN haloperidol order may be used only for severe agitation that creates an imminent safety threat after non-pharmacologic measures fail. Which nursing actions are appropriate before or after giving this medication? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 阶段2：按需氟哌啶醇医嘱仅可用于非药物措施失败后、造成即刻安全威胁的严重躁动。给药前后哪些护理措施合适？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Review ECG/QTc status, potassium/magnesium status, and other QT-prolonging medications per facility protocol.
options.zh: 按机构流程查看心电图/QTc、钾/镁状态以及其他延长QT的药物。

options.en: Document the specific safety threat and the non-pharmacologic measures attempted before giving the dose.
options.zh: 给药前记录具体安全威胁以及已尝试的非药物措施。

options.en: After administration, reassess agitation, level of sedation, blood pressure, and extrapyramidal symptoms.
options.zh: 给药后复评躁动、镇静程度、血压和锥体外系反应。

options.en: Use physical restraints automatically after the medication takes effect to keep the client in bed.
options.zh: 药物起效后自动使用身体约束，使患者留在床上。

options.en: Screen for Parkinson disease or dementia with Lewy bodies before using haloperidol.
options.zh: 使用氟哌啶醇前筛查帕金森病或路易体痴呆。

options.en: Give the medication routinely at bedtime to prevent all nighttime confusion.
options.zh: 每晚睡前常规给药，以预防所有夜间意识混乱。

correct.en: For delirium-related agitation in a frail older adult, antipsychotic medication is reserved for an imminent safety threat after least-restrictive measures fail. The nurse should document the indication and failed alternatives, complete ordered or protocol-based cardiac/electrolyte and contraindication checks, and monitor effectiveness and adverse effects after administration.
correct.zh: 对于体弱老年人谵妄相关躁动，抗精神病药仅限于限制性较小措施失败且存在即刻安全威胁时使用。护士应记录适应证和失败的替代措施，完成医嘱或流程要求的心脏/电解质及禁忌证核查，并在给药后监测疗效和不良反应。

byChoice.en: The order requires failed non-pharmacologic measures and an imminent threat; documentation shows the medication is not being used for convenience.
byChoice.zh: 该医嘱要求非药物措施失败且存在即刻威胁；记录可证明用药不是为了方便照护。

byChoice.en: Parkinson disease and dementia with Lewy bodies increase risk of severe sensitivity or worsening motor symptoms with dopamine-blocking antipsychotics.
byChoice.zh: 帕金森病和路易体痴呆会增加多巴胺阻断类抗精神病药严重敏感反应或运动症状加重的风险。

byChoice.en: Haloperidol can prolong QT; ECG/QTc, electrolyte status, and other QT-prolonging drugs are safety checks before use when feasible.
byChoice.zh: 氟哌啶醇可延长QT；可行时用药前应核查心电图/QTc、电解质状态和其他延长QT药物。

byChoice.en: Restraints are not automatic after medication; they can worsen delirium and should remain a last resort under policy.
byChoice.zh: 给药后不能自动约束；约束可能加重谵妄，应始终按政策作为最后手段。

byChoice.en: Routine prophylactic sedation is not appropriate; the order is PRN for severe safety-threatening agitation only after other measures fail.
byChoice.zh: 常规预防性镇静不合适；该医嘱仅在严重且威胁安全的躁动、其他措施失败后按需使用。

byChoice.en: Monitoring response, oversedation, hypotension, and extrapyramidal effects evaluates both benefit and medication harm.
byChoice.zh: 监测反应、过度镇静、低血压和锥体外系反应，可评估疗效和药物伤害。

testTakingStrategy.en: When a PRN psychotropic is ordered for delirium, look for the triad: clear safety indication, failed non-drug measures, and monitoring for high-risk adverse effects.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 谵妄患者有按需精神类药物医嘱时，寻找三要素：明确安全适应证、非药物措施失败，以及高风险不良反应监测。

glossary.defZh: 心电图指标，延长时会增加严重室性心律失常风险。
抗精神病药可能引起的肌强直、震颤、急性肌张力障碍或静坐不能等运动副作用。
根据患者情况和医嘱条件使用，而不是固定时间常规使用。

stem.en: Stage 3: Compare the client's findings across the case. For each finding, indicate whether it shows the current interventions are working or whether it requires continued monitoring because the problem has not fully resolved.
stem.zh: 阶段3：比较整个案例中的患者资料。对每项发现，判断其显示当前干预正在奏效，还是因问题尚未完全解决而需要继续监测。

rows.en: Creatinine improves from 1.3 mg/dL to 1.0 mg/dL and BUN decreases from 32 mg/dL to 24 mg/dL
rows.zh: 肌酐从1.3 mg/dL改善到1.0 mg/dL，BUN从32 mg/dL降至24 mg/dL

rows.en: Urine output improves from 40 mL in 2 hr to 320 mL in 8 hr with pale-yellow urine
rows.zh: 尿量从2小时40 mL改善为8小时320 mL，尿色淡黄

rows.en: Temperature normalizes and WBC decreases from 14.2 ×10³/µL to 10.4 ×10³/µL
rows.zh: 体温恢复正常，白细胞从14.2 ×10³/µL降至10.4 ×10³/µL

rows.en: CAM remains positive and the client is still disoriented to place and year
rows.zh: CAM仍阳性，患者仍不能定向到地点和年份

rows.en: The client eats half of a soft breakfast with cueing but has not yet tolerated a full meal
rows.zh: 患者在提示下吃了半份软食早餐，但尚未能耐受完整一餐

columns.zh: 继续监测/尚未完全解决

correct.en: Improving creatinine, BUN, sodium, urine output, fever, and WBC trend show that fluids and antibiotic therapy are addressing dehydration, prerenal kidney injury, and infection. However, a positive CAM, ongoing disorientation, and incomplete oral intake mean delirium and functional recovery are not complete and discharge planning still requires supervision and reassessment.
correct.zh: 肌酐、BUN、钠、尿量、体温和白细胞趋势改善，说明补液和抗生素治疗正在处理脱水、肾前性肾损伤和感染。但是CAM仍阳性、仍有定向障碍且口服摄入不完整，说明谵妄和功能恢复尚未完成，出院计划仍需监督和复评。

byChoice.en: Creatinine returning toward baseline with falling BUN supports resolving prerenal kidney injury.
byChoice.zh: 肌酐接近基线且BUN下降，支持肾前性肾损伤正在缓解。

byChoice.en: Improved urine output and lighter color show better hydration and renal perfusion.
byChoice.zh: 尿量增加且颜色变浅，显示水合状态和肾灌注改善。

byChoice.en: Defervescence and WBC improvement suggest the infection and inflammatory response are responding to treatment.
byChoice.zh: 退热和白细胞改善提示感染及炎症反应对治疗有反应。

byChoice.en: Improved but persistent CAM positivity means delirium is not resolved and safety planning must continue.
byChoice.zh: CAM虽改善但仍阳性，说明谵妄尚未解除，仍需继续安全计划。

byChoice.en: Partial intake is encouraging, but inadequate intake remains a risk for dehydration, malnutrition, and delayed discharge readiness.
byChoice.zh: 部分进食令人鼓舞，但摄入不足仍会增加脱水、营养不良和延迟达到出院条件的风险。

testTakingStrategy.en: Trend questions are not solved by one value. Compare direction over time and separate physiologic improvement from unresolved safety or functional problems.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 趋势题不能只看单个数值。要比较随时间变化的方向，并区分生理改善与尚未解决的安全或功能问题。

glossary.defZh: 反映蛋白代谢和肾脏排泄情况的实验室指标，可随脱水升高。
常用于评估肾功能的实验室指标，急性升高提示可能肾损伤。
发热消退，常提示感染或炎症反应改善。

stem.en: Stage 3: The daughter asks, "She's better but still not herself — when will she be back to normal?" Which response by the nurse is most appropriate?
stem.zh: 阶段3：女儿问：“她好多了，但还不像自己——什么时候才能恢复正常？”护士哪项回应最合适？

options.en: "The improvement is encouraging. Delirium often clears gradually over days to weeks, sometimes longer in someone with dementia. Our goal is return to her usual baseline, and the facility will need to know what supervision she still needs."
options.zh: “她的改善令人鼓舞。谵妄通常会在数天到数周内逐渐缓解，有痴呆的人有时需要更久。我们的目标是让她回到平时基线，协助生活机构也需要了解她仍需要哪些监督。”

options.en: "This behavior means her dementia has permanently advanced, so you should arrange memory-care placement now."
options.zh: “这种行为说明她的痴呆已经永久进展，所以你现在就应该安排记忆照护机构。”

options.en: "Since the antibiotic is working, she should be completely back to normal by tomorrow."
options.zh: “既然抗生素有效，她明天应该就能完全恢复正常。”

options.en: "Try not to ask about the timeline; talking about it can make her confusion worse."
options.zh: “尽量不要问恢复时间；谈这个会让她更混乱。”

correct.en: This response validates the daughter's concern, recognizes that improvement is real, sets realistic expectations that delirium may resolve more slowly than infection markers, and frames the goal as return to the client's baseline rather than immediate full orientation. It also connects persistent delirium to safe discharge planning.
correct.zh: 该回应肯定女儿的担忧，承认改善是真实的，并说明谵妄的缓解可能比感染指标改善更慢；同时把目标设定为恢复到患者原有基线，而不是立即完全定向，并将持续谵妄与安全出院计划联系起来。

byChoice.en: This overpromises rapid recovery and may increase family distress if cognition lags behind medical improvement.
byChoice.zh: 该说法过度承诺快速恢复；如果认知恢复落后于医学改善，可能增加家属焦虑。

byChoice.en: This is therapeutic, accurate, and discharge-focused without overpromising or treating the episode as permanent decline.
byChoice.zh: 该回应具有治疗性且准确，关注出院安全，既不过度承诺，也不把本次发作视为永久衰退。

byChoice.en: Avoiding the question is not therapeutic; the family needs clear expectations and safety planning.
byChoice.zh: 回避问题不具治疗性；家属需要明确预期和安全计划。

byChoice.en: Immediate memory-care placement based on an active delirium episode is premature; reassessment after recovery is needed.
byChoice.zh: 在谵妄仍活动时立即根据当前表现安排记忆照护为时过早；需恢复后再评估。

testTakingStrategy.en: Therapeutic communication answers usually acknowledge feelings, give accurate information, and avoid false reassurance or premature conclusions.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 治疗性沟通选项通常会承认感受、提供准确信息，并避免虚假安慰或过早下结论。

glossary.defZh: 通过倾听、确认感受和提供准确信息来支持患者或家属的沟通方式。
患者急性生病前通常的认知和功能水平。
根据患者当前和预期需要安排安全出院环境、照护和随访。

stem.en: Stage 2: The client has a Braden Scale score of 14, high fall risk, poor intake, urinary incontinence, disrupted sleep, and ongoing confusion. Which nursing interventions reduce hospital-acquired complication risk? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 阶段2：患者Braden评分14分、跌倒风险高、摄入差、尿失禁、睡眠中断且仍意识混乱。哪些护理措施能降低医院获得性并发症风险？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Cluster nighttime care, reduce noise and light at night, and maintain daytime orientation cues.
options.zh: 夜间集中护理操作、减少噪声和光线，并在白天保持定向线索。

options.en: Reposition at least every 2 hr, use pressure redistribution as indicated, keep skin clean and dry, and apply moisture barrier to the perineum.
options.zh: 至少每2小时翻身，按需使用减压/压力再分布措施，保持皮肤清洁干燥，并在会阴部使用防潮屏障。

options.en: Turn off the bed alarm because alarms can be annoying for confused clients.
options.zh: 关闭床报警，因为报警声会让意识混乱的患者烦躁。

options.en: Maintain fall precautions such as bed in lowest position, bed alarm, non-skid footwear, clear pathways, and purposeful rounding.
options.zh: 维持跌倒预防措施，如床置最低位、床报警、防滑鞋、通道清理和有目的巡视。

options.en: Offer small frequent meals, fluids, and cueing; escalate nutrition support if intake does not improve.
options.zh: 提供少量多餐、液体和提示；若摄入未改善，升级营养支持。

options.en: Keep the client in bed with restraints so she does not remove the IV or fall.
options.zh: 用约束让患者留在床上，以免拔除静脉通路或跌倒。

correct.en: Delirium, immobility, incontinence, poor intake, sleep disruption, and Braden score 14 create overlapping risks for falls, pressure injury, dehydration, malnutrition, and prolonged delirium. Prevention requires a bundle: fall precautions, skin and moisture care, nutrition/hydration support, and sleep-preserving delirium care.
correct.zh: 谵妄、活动受限、尿失禁、摄入差、睡眠中断和Braden评分14分共同增加跌倒、压力性损伤、脱水、营养不良和谵妄延长的风险。预防需要成套措施：跌倒预防、皮肤与潮湿管理、营养/水合支持，以及保护睡眠的谵妄护理。

byChoice.en: These measures address the documented high fall risk without jumping to restraints.
byChoice.zh: 这些措施能处理已记录的高跌倒风险，而不直接使用约束。

byChoice.en: Sleep preservation and day-night orientation reduce delirium triggers while still allowing needed care.
byChoice.zh: 保护睡眠和维持昼夜定向可减少谵妄诱因，同时仍能完成必要护理。

byChoice.en: The bed alarm is part of the fall-prevention plan; removing it without an alternative increases injury risk.
byChoice.zh: 床报警是跌倒预防计划的一部分；在没有替代措施时关闭会增加受伤风险。

byChoice.en: Braden score 14 plus incontinence and reduced mobility justify pressure-injury prevention and moisture protection.
byChoice.zh: Braden评分14分，加上尿失禁和活动受限，支持进行压力性损伤预防和防潮保护。

byChoice.en: Restraints are not a routine fall-prevention tool and can worsen agitation, injury risk, and delirium.
byChoice.zh: 约束不是常规跌倒预防工具，还可能加重躁动、受伤风险和谵妄。

byChoice.en: Poor intake worsens dehydration, weakness, and delirium risk; cueing and escalation support recovery.
byChoice.zh: 摄入差会加重脱水、虚弱和谵妄风险；提示进食和升级支持有助恢复。

testTakingStrategy.en: When several geriatric risks converge, choose bundled prevention measures that address mobility, skin, nutrition, hydration, sleep, and safety together.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当多个老年风险同时存在时，选择成套预防措施，同时处理活动、皮肤、营养、水合、睡眠和安全。

glossary.defZh: 用于评估压力性损伤风险的工具，分数越低风险越高。
涂抹于皮肤表面以减少尿液或粪便刺激的保护用品。
定期主动查看疼痛、如厕、位置和物品可及性等需求的护理方式。

correct.en: The case shows acute hyperactive delirium superimposed on baseline dementia, precipitated by symptomatic urinary tract infection with dehydration and prerenal kidney injury. The priority nursing judgments are to recognize the abrupt fluctuating change from baseline, protect the client from falls and injury using least-restrictive non-pharmacologic delirium measures, treat reversible contributors, use antipsychotic medication only for imminent safety threats after non-pharmacologic measures fail and required safety checks are completed, trend renal and infection markers to evaluate response, and communicate realistic recovery expectations to the family.
correct.zh: 本案例显示患者在基线痴呆基础上发生急性活动过度型谵妄，诱因是伴有脱水和肾前性肾损伤的有症状尿路感染。护理判断重点包括：识别与基线相比突然且波动的改变；用限制性最小的非药物谵妄护理措施保护患者避免跌倒和伤害；处理可逆诱因；只有在存在即刻安全威胁、非药物措施失败并完成必要安全核查后才使用抗精神病药；通过肾功能和感染指标趋势评估疗效；并向家属说明现实的恢复预期。

testTakingStrategy.en: For unfolding cases, first separate baseline from acute change, then ask what threatens safety now and what trend shows whether the intervention is working.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 做展开案例时，先区分基线和急性改变，再判断当前最威胁安全的因素，以及哪些趋势能说明干预是否有效。

glossary.defZh: 急性、波动性的注意力和认知障碍，常由感染、药物、脱水或其他急性问题诱发。
用于筛查谵妄的工具，关注急性起病、注意力不集中、思维紊乱和意识水平改变。
由于肾脏灌注不足导致的急性肾功能下降，常见于脱水、低血容量或感染。
在保证安全的前提下优先使用对患者自由和尊严限制最少的措施。

stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
stem.zh: 查看患儿病历，并回答病例题。

title.en: Suspected nonaccidental trauma in a toddler with occult fractures and inconsistent caregiver history
title.zh: 幼儿疑似非意外性创伤：隐匿性骨折伴照护者病史不一致

summary.en: A 22-month-old boy is brought to the emergency department by his mother's boyfriend after a reported fall from a couch. The child has left arm pain, patterned bruising in concerning locations, and later imaging reveals occult healing fractures in addition to the acute injury.
summary.zh: 一名22个月男童由母亲男友带至急诊，据称从沙发跌落。患儿左臂疼痛，并有位于可疑部位的图案性瘀伤；后续影像除急性损伤外，还发现隐匿的愈合期骨折。

content.en:
Background: 22-month-old boy brought by mother's boyfriend, who reports the child fell off a couch onto carpet about 1 hour ago and will not stop crying. The mother is at work and has not yet been contacted. The boyfriend reports being the primary daytime caregiver for about 3 months. No known bleeding disorder, metabolic bone disease, or significant past medical history. Immunizations are up to date per state registry. No prior CPS involvement is documented.

Orders placed: skeletal survey, CT head without contrast, BMP, CBC with differential, coagulation studies, AST/ALT, lipase, urinalysis, continuous cardiorespiratory monitoring, and peripheral IV.

Caregiver statements: The boyfriend says the child is "always a crybaby" and "does this for attention." He reports no loss of consciousness, vomiting, or seizure activity and initially declines to call the mother.
content.zh:
背景：22个月男童由母亲男友带至急诊。男友称患儿约1小时前从沙发跌到地毯上，之后一直哭闹。母亲正在上班，尚未被联系。男友称自己约3个月来是白天主要照护者。患儿无已知出血性疾病、代谢性骨病或重要既往病史。州登记显示免疫接种已按时完成。系统中无既往儿童保护服务（CPS）介入记录。

已开立医嘱：骨骼系统筛查X线、头颅CT平扫、基础代谢面板、全血细胞计数及分类、凝血功能、AST/ALT、脂肪酶、尿液分析、连续心肺监测和外周静脉通路。

照护者陈述：男友说患儿“总是爱哭”“这样是为了引人注意”。他否认患儿有意识丧失、呕吐或癫痫样发作，并起初拒绝联系母亲。

title.zh: 初始评估与实验室资料

content.en:
Weight 12.4 kg, length 86 cm. T 99 °F (37.2 °C), HR 152, BP 96/58, RR 28, SpO2 99% on room air.

Neurologic/head: crying but arousable, tracks faces, pupils equal and reactive, anterior fontanelle closed and flat, no hemotympanum, oral mucosa moist, no frenulum tear.

Musculoskeletal/skin: left upper extremity swelling and point tenderness over the mid-humerus with guarding; the child screams and withdraws when palpated. Distal radial pulse intact; capillary refill <2 seconds; fingers pink and warm. Right upper extremity moves freely. Four circular, well-demarcated bruises about 1 cm each on the left lateral chest wall. Two linear bruises about 3 cm and 5 cm on the posterior right thigh. Fading yellow-green bruise about 2 × 3 cm on the left scapular region. Abdomen soft and non-distended; no abdominal or genital bruising. No petechiae.

Labs: WBC 9.8 ×10³/µL, Hgb 11.4 g/dL, platelets 312 ×10³/µL. Sodium 139 mEq/L, potassium 4.3 mEq/L, creatinine 0.3 mg/dL, glucose 94 mg/dL, calcium 9.8 mg/dL. PT 12.8 seconds, INR 1.0, PTT 28 seconds. AST 34 U/L, ALT 28 U/L, lipase 42 U/L. Urinalysis negative for blood, protein, and leukocyte esterase.
content.zh:
体重12.4 kg，身长86 cm。体温99 °F (37.2 °C)，心率152次/分，血压96/58 mmHg，呼吸28次/分，室内空气SpO2 99%。

神经/头部：患儿哭闹但可唤醒，能追视面孔，双瞳等大等圆并对光反应，前囟已闭合且平坦，无鼓室积血，口腔黏膜湿润，无系带撕裂。

肌肉骨骼/皮肤：左上肢肿胀，中段肱骨处点状压痛并保护性固定；触诊时患儿尖叫并回缩。远端桡动脉搏动存在；毛细血管再充盈<2秒；手指粉红温暖。右上肢活动自如。左侧胸壁外侧有4处圆形、边界清楚、每处约1 cm的瘀伤。右大腿后侧有2条线状瘀伤，约3 cm和5 cm。左肩胛区有一处约2 × 3 cm、颜色变淡的黄绿色瘀伤。腹部柔软、无胀，无腹部或外生殖器瘀伤。无瘀点。

实验室：WBC 9.8 ×10³/µL，Hgb 11.4 g/dL，血小板312 ×10³/µL。钠139 mEq/L，钾4.3 mEq/L，肌酐0.3 mg/dL，血糖94 mg/dL，钙9.8 mg/dL。PT 12.8秒，INR 1.0，PTT 28秒。AST 34 U/L，ALT 28 U/L，脂肪酶42 U/L。尿液分析：无血、无蛋白、白细胞酯酶阴性。

title.zh: 影像结果与照护者动态

content.en:
Skeletal survey: transverse fracture of the left humeral shaft with minimal displacement; healing posterior rib fracture of the left 8th rib with callus formation estimated at 2–3 weeks old; healing classic metaphyseal lesion (corner fracture) of the right distal tibia with early callus formation. CT head is negative for intracranial hemorrhage or skull fracture.

The boyfriend now states the child "falls a lot" and "bruises easily." When asked about the rib and tibial injuries, he says he was unaware of prior injuries and suggests the child may have hurt himself in his crib. The mother arrives, is visibly upset, and says she was unaware of injuries other than today's. She reports the boyfriend "gets frustrated sometimes" but denies witnessing physical discipline. The child clings to the mother and turns away from the boyfriend. HR decreases to 128 with the mother present.

The ED physician states the injury pattern is highly concerning for nonaccidental trauma and that a mandatory report to CPS is being filed. The boyfriend becomes agitated and says, "You can't just accuse me — kids get hurt all the time."
content.zh:
骨骼系统筛查X线：左肱骨干横行骨折，移位轻微；左第8后肋愈合期骨折并有骨痂形成，估计伤龄2–3周；右胫骨远端愈合期典型干骺端损伤（角部骨折），已有早期骨痂。头颅CT未见颅内出血或颅骨骨折。

男友现在称患儿“经常摔倒”“容易瘀青”。问及肋骨和胫骨伤时，他称不知道既往受伤，并推测患儿可能是在婴儿床里弄伤自己。母亲到达后明显难过，称除今天的伤外，她并不知道其他受伤。她说男友“有时会很烦躁”，但否认亲眼见过体罚。患儿紧贴母亲，并转身避开男友。母亲在场后心率降至128次/分。

急诊医生说明该损伤模式高度令人担忧为非意外性创伤，并正在向CPS进行强制报告。男友变得激动并说：“你们不能就这样指控我——孩子总会受伤。”

content.en:
A CPS investigator arrives and interviews the mother and boyfriend separately with the ED social worker present. When interviewed alone, the mother tearfully discloses that the boyfriend has "grabbed" the child roughly several times. She once saw a bruise on the child's chest about 2 weeks ago, but the boyfriend told her the child bumped into a doorknob. She says she fears he will "lose his temper" if she says anything and asks the nurse, "Can you just not tell him what I said? I'm scared he'll hurt me too."

Hospital security has been notified and the boyfriend is asked to wait in a separate area. The child receives weight-based ibuprofen per order, and orthopedics applies a posterior splint to the left upper extremity. The child is calmer. HR 118, BP 92/56, RR 24, SpO2 99%. FLACC score 4, down from 8 at presentation.

The CPS investigator requests that the child not be discharged until a safety plan is established. The ED physician orders admission to the pediatric unit for further evaluation, pain management, and coordination with CPS and the child abuse team.
content.zh:
CPS调查员到达，并在急诊社工在场的情况下分别访谈母亲和男友。母亲单独受访时哭着透露，男友曾多次粗暴地“抓”患儿。她约2周前曾看到患儿胸部有瘀伤，但男友说是患儿撞到门把手。她表示害怕自己说出来后男友会“发脾气”，并问护士：“你能不能不要告诉他我说了什么？我也怕他会伤害我。”

医院安保已被通知，男友被要求在单独区域等待。患儿按医嘱接受按体重计算的布洛芬止痛，骨科为左上肢上后侧夹板。患儿较平静。心率118次/分，血压92/56 mmHg，呼吸24次/分，SpO2 99%。FLACC评分4分，较入院时8分下降。

CPS调查员要求在建立安全计划前不要让患儿出院。急诊医生下达住院至儿科病房医嘱，以便进一步评估、疼痛管理，并与CPS及儿童虐待团队协调。

title.en: Stage 3: 8 hours after arrival, pediatric unit
title.zh: 第3阶段：到院后8小时，儿科病房

title.en: Child abuse team evaluation and discharge planning
title.zh: 儿童虐待团队评估与出院计划

content.en:
The child abuse pediatrician documents multiple injuries in various stages of healing, a developmentally inconsistent injury pattern, and a history inconsistent with the injury mechanism. The findings are described as highly concerning for inflicted injury/nonaccidental trauma. A follow-up skeletal survey is ordered for 2 weeks per child abuse team protocol to identify additional occult fractures not visible on initial imaging.

The mother is at the bedside and asks, "What's going to happen to my son? Will they take him away from me?" She is tearful and says she feels guilty for not protecting him. The child is resting comfortably. HR 110, BP 90/54, RR 22, SpO2 99%, FLACC score 2. He is taking oral fluids and small amounts of food.

CPS informs nursing staff that a temporary safety plan is established: the boyfriend is not permitted to have unsupervised contact with the child, and the mother has agreed to a safety plan that includes a temporary protective order. CPS asks the nurse to document the child's behavioral responses to each visitor and to notify CPS immediately if the boyfriend attempts to visit. Discharge planning is initiated with the social worker, CPS, and the mother.
content.zh:
儿童虐待专科儿科医生记录：患儿存在不同愈合阶段的多处损伤，损伤模式与发育阶段不一致，病史与损伤机制不一致；这些发现高度提示蓄意损伤/非意外性创伤。儿童虐待团队按方案开立2周后复查骨骼系统筛查X线，以识别初次影像未显示的其他隐匿骨折。

母亲在床旁问：“我儿子接下来会怎样？他们会把他从我身边带走吗？”她流泪，并说自己因没能保护他而感到内疚。患儿休息舒适。心率110次/分，血压90/54 mmHg，呼吸22次/分，SpO2 99%，FLACC评分2分。患儿可口服液体并少量进食。

CPS通知护理人员，临时安全计划已建立：男友不得与患儿有无人监督的接触，母亲已同意包含临时保护令的安全计划。CPS要求护士记录患儿对每位访客的行为反应，并在男友试图探视时立即通知CPS。社工、CPS和母亲共同启动出院计划。

stem.en: At initial presentation, before imaging results are available, which nursing actions are appropriate? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 在初始就诊时、影像结果出来之前，护士采取哪些行动是合适的？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Continue pain assessment and neurovascular checks of the injured left arm while avoiding unnecessary manipulation.
options.zh: 继续评估疼痛并检查受伤左臂的神经血管状态，同时避免不必要的搬动或牵拉。

options.en: Tell the boyfriend that the bruises prove child abuse and that he caused the injuries.
options.zh: 告诉男友这些瘀伤证明存在虐待，并且就是他造成了损伤。

options.en: Communicate to the ED physician that the patterned bruising and locations are inconsistent with the reported short fall.
options.zh: 告知急诊医生：这些图案性瘀伤及其部位与所述短距离跌落不一致。

options.en: Delay documentation until the skeletal survey confirms whether fractures are present.
options.zh: 等骨骼系统筛查X线确认是否有骨折后，再记录瘀伤情况。

options.en: Document each bruise objectively, including size, shape, color, and exact anatomic location, using a body map if available.
options.zh: 客观记录每处瘀伤，包括大小、形状、颜色和精确解剖位置；如有身体图，应使用身体图。

options.en: Accept the caregiver's explanation because toddlers commonly fall and bruise during play.
options.zh: 接受照护者解释，因为幼儿在玩耍时经常摔倒并出现瘀伤。

correct.en: The initial bruising pattern is a safety and reporting cue even before imaging. Objective documentation, prompt communication to the provider, and ongoing pain/neurovascular assessment protect the child and preserve a clear record without assigning legal guilt.
correct.zh: 即使影像尚未出来，初始瘀伤模式已是安全和报告线索。客观记录、及时告知医师，并持续进行疼痛和神经血管评估，有助于保护患儿并保留清晰记录，同时不作法律定责。

byChoice.en: Precise, objective documentation of bruise size, shape, color, and location supports clinical communication and forensic clarity without drawing a legal conclusion.
byChoice.zh: 准确、客观记录瘀伤的大小、形状、颜色和位置，有助于临床沟通和法医学清晰性，同时避免作出法律结论。

byChoice.en: The nurse should not accuse, determine guilt, or confront the caregiver; that can escalate danger and exceeds the nursing role.
byChoice.zh: 护士不应指控、判断责任或对照护者进行对质；这样可能升级危险，也超出护理职责。

byChoice.en: The injured extremity still needs routine fracture care: pain assessment and distal circulation, movement, and sensation checks.
byChoice.zh: 受伤肢体仍需常规骨折护理：评估疼痛，并检查远端循环、运动和感觉。

byChoice.en: Patterned bruises on the lateral chest wall, posterior thigh, and scapular region are not typical simple fall contact points and should be escalated to the provider.
byChoice.zh: 胸壁外侧、大腿后侧和肩胛区的图案性瘀伤，不符合普通跌倒的典型接触点，应向医师升级沟通。

byChoice.en: Bruising should be documented when observed; waiting can weaken the record and does not protect the child.
byChoice.zh: 观察到瘀伤时就应记录；等待会削弱记录质量，也不利于保护患儿。

byChoice.en: Toddlers do fall, but the pattern, locations, and varying bruise appearance make accepting the explanation without escalation unsafe.
byChoice.zh: 幼儿确实会摔倒，但瘀伤的形态、部位和不同外观提示风险，未经升级处理就接受解释是不安全的。

testTakingStrategy.en: For suspected abuse, separate objective nursing actions from legal conclusions: document, report concerns through proper channels, maintain safety, and continue clinical assessment.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 遇到疑似虐待时，要区分客观护理行动和法律结论：记录、通过正确渠道报告疑虑、维持安全，并继续临床评估。

glossary.defZh: 形状或排列提示可能由物体、抓握或特定受力方式造成的瘀伤。
用于标注损伤精确位置、大小和形态的记录工具。
评估受伤肢体远端循环、感觉、运动、皮肤温度和颜色的检查。

stem.en: Stage 1 imaging results are available. For each finding, classify how it should affect the nurse's concern about nonaccidental trauma.
stem.zh: 第1阶段影像结果已出。请判断每项发现对护士关于非意外性创伤疑虑的影响。

rows.en: Healing posterior left 8th rib fracture with callus formation
rows.zh: 左第8后肋愈合期骨折并有骨痂形成

rows.en: Healing classic metaphyseal lesion of the right distal tibia
rows.zh: 右胫骨远端愈合期典型干骺端损伤

rows.en: Multiple fractures in different stages of healing with vague, shifting explanations
rows.zh: 不同愈合阶段的多处骨折，且解释含糊、前后变化

rows.en: Negative CT head for intracranial hemorrhage or skull fracture
rows.zh: 头颅CT未见颅内出血或颅骨骨折

rows.en: Normal PT/INR/PTT and normal serum calcium
rows.zh: PT/INR/PTT正常，血钙正常

columns.en: Does not explain away the concern or justify delaying the report
columns.zh: 不能解释掉疑虑，也不能作为延迟报告的理由

columns.en: Supports reasonable suspicion and need for safety/reporting actions
columns.zh: 支持合理怀疑，需要采取安全和报告行动

correct.en: Posterior rib fracture, classic metaphyseal lesion, multiple injuries in different healing stages, and inconsistent explanations together support reasonable suspicion and safety/reporting actions. A negative head CT and normal coagulation/calcium results do not erase the concern created by the skeletal findings and history.
correct.zh: 后肋骨折、典型干骺端损伤、不同愈合阶段的多处损伤以及不一致解释，共同支持合理怀疑并需要采取安全和报告行动。头颅CT阴性以及凝血/钙正常，不能消除骨骼发现和病史所造成的疑虑。

byChoice.en: A healing posterior rib fracture in this context is a high-concern skeletal finding, especially because the reported couch fall does not explain an older rib injury.
byChoice.zh: 在此情境下，愈合期后肋骨折是高度可疑的骨骼发现，尤其是所述沙发跌落不能解释较早发生的肋骨损伤。

byChoice.en: A classic metaphyseal lesion with callus formation is highly concerning when the caregiver history does not provide a plausible mechanism.
byChoice.zh: 在照护者病史不能提供合理机制时，带骨痂的典型干骺端损伤高度令人担忧。

byChoice.en: Repeated injuries at different healing stages plus shifting explanations increase concern for inflicted injury and trigger reporting/safety responsibilities.
byChoice.zh: 不同愈合阶段的反复损伤加上前后变化的解释，会增加对蓄意损伤的担忧，并触发报告和安全职责。

byChoice.en: No intracranial injury is reassuring for neurologic status, but it does not negate the skeletal and bruising concerns.
byChoice.zh: 未见颅内损伤对神经状态较为安慰，但不能否定骨骼和瘀伤方面的疑虑。

byChoice.en: Normal coagulation studies and calcium reduce some alternative explanations but do not justify delaying a report when suspicious injuries are present.
byChoice.zh: 凝血功能和血钙正常可减少某些替代解释，但在可疑损伤存在时，不能作为延迟报告的理由。

testTakingStrategy.en: Do not let one reassuring result cancel out multiple high-concern cues. Weigh the pattern, timing, developmental plausibility, and consistency of the history.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 不要让一个看似安慰的结果抵消多个高度可疑线索。要综合损伤模式、时间、发育阶段合理性以及病史一致性。

glossary.defZh: 用于评估儿童多处或隐匿骨折的一组系统性影像检查。
发生在肋骨后部的骨折；在幼儿中若病史不相符，应高度关注非意外性创伤。
靠近生长板的特殊骨折模式，也称角部骨折；在疑似虐待评估中是重要线索。
基于临床线索足以触发报告和安全行动的怀疑程度，不要求护士证明法律责任。

stem.en: During Stage 2, the mother discloses fear of the boyfriend and asks the nurse not to tell him what she said. Which nursing responses are appropriate? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 第2阶段，母亲透露自己害怕男友，并请护士不要把她的话告诉男友。哪些护理回应是合适的？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Tell the boyfriend what the mother disclosed so he can respond to the allegation directly.
options.zh: 把母亲透露的内容告诉男友，让他直接回应指控。

options.en: Explain that the team will protect her confidentiality to the greatest extent possible and will not share her specific statements with the boyfriend.
options.zh: 说明团队会在最大可能范围内保护她的保密性，不会把她的具体陈述告诉男友。

options.en: Acknowledge her fear and validate that it was important to disclose safety concerns.
options.zh: 承认她的害怕，并肯定她说出安全担忧是重要的。

options.en: Offer domestic violence resources and continue safety-focused, nonjudgmental support.
options.zh: 提供家庭暴力相关资源，并继续给予以安全为重点、非评判性的支持。

options.en: Advise the mother to confront the boyfriend in the hospital while security is nearby.
options.zh: 建议母亲趁安保在附近时，在医院里当面对质男友。

options.en: Ensure the social worker and CPS investigator know about the domestic violence concern so the safety plan addresses both the child and the mother.
options.zh: 确保社工和CPS调查员了解家庭暴力担忧，使安全计划同时涵盖患儿和母亲。

correct.en: The mother may be a protective caregiver and a victim at risk. The nurse should respond therapeutically, protect confidentiality from the alleged perpetrator as much as possible, involve the appropriate safety-planning team, and provide resources. Confrontation or disclosure to the boyfriend can increase danger.
correct.zh: 母亲可能既是保护性照护者，也可能是处于危险中的受害者。护士应以治疗性沟通回应，尽可能避免向疑似施害者透露她的具体陈述，联系适当的安全计划团队，并提供资源。对质或向男友透露内容可能增加危险。

byChoice.en: Sharing the mother's statement with the boyfriend could escalate danger and is not part of the nurse's role.
byChoice.zh: 把母亲的陈述告诉男友可能升级危险，也不是护士的职责。

byChoice.en: Confidentiality should be protected as much as possible; the boyfriend does not need the mother's specific statements for the nurse to maintain safety and reporting duties.
byChoice.zh: 应尽可能保护保密性；护士维持安全和报告职责，并不需要让男友知道母亲的具体陈述。

byChoice.en: CPS and social work need the disclosure to build a safety plan that addresses risk to both the child and the mother.
byChoice.zh: CPS和社工需要了解该披露，才能制定同时处理患儿和母亲风险的安全计划。

byChoice.en: Validation supports disclosure, reduces shame, and keeps the focus on safety rather than blame.
byChoice.zh: 给予肯定有助于支持披露、减轻羞耻感，并把重点放在安全而非责备上。

byChoice.en: Domestic violence resources and nonjudgmental support are appropriate nursing interventions after a disclosure.
byChoice.zh: 在披露家庭暴力担忧后，提供相关资源和非评判性支持是恰当的护理干预。

byChoice.en: Encouraging confrontation can increase risk; safety planning should be coordinated through trained staff and protective agencies.
byChoice.zh: 鼓励对质可能增加风险；安全计划应由受过训练的工作人员和保护机构协调。

testTakingStrategy.en: When a client or caregiver discloses interpersonal violence, prioritize safety, confidentiality from the alleged perpetrator, validation, and referral to trained resources.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当患者或照护者披露人际暴力时，优先考虑安全、避免向疑似施害者泄密、给予肯定，并转介到受过训练的资源。

glossary.defZh: 亲密伴侣或家庭成员之间的身体、心理、性或控制性伤害行为。
为降低受害者和儿童风险而制定的具体保护措施和行动安排。
以尊重、倾听和支持为基础，帮助患者表达感受并促进安全决策的沟通方式。

stem.en: Complete the statement describing the nurse's appropriate response to the agitated caregiver.
stem.zh: 完成下列语句，说明护士对激动照护者的恰当回应。

clozeStem.en: The nurse should explain that the CPS report is based on {{1}}, and should avoid {{2}}.
clozeStem.zh: 护士应说明，向CPS报告是基于 {{1}}，并应避免 {{2}}。

options.en: reasonable suspicion and a legal reporting obligation, not a hospital determination of guilt
options.zh: 合理怀疑和法定报告义务，而不是医院对责任的判定

options.en: the mother's permission to involve protective services
options.zh: 母亲同意联系保护服务机构

options.en: definitive proof that the caregiver intentionally injured the child
options.zh: 照护者故意伤害患儿的确凿证明

options.en: asking security for assistance if behavior threatens safety
options.zh: 如果其行为威胁安全，向安保请求协助

options.en: debating guilt, confronting him with accusations, or attempting a forensic interview
options.zh: 辩论责任、以指控方式对质，或试图进行法医式访谈

options.en: documenting his statements verbatim in the medical record
options.zh: 在病历中逐字记录他的陈述

correct.en: Mandatory reporting is triggered by reasonable suspicion and safety concerns; it is not the nurse's role to prove abuse, determine guilt, or conduct an interrogation. The nurse should remain calm, explain the duty to report, document objectively, and preserve safety.
correct.zh: 强制报告由合理怀疑和安全担忧触发；护士的职责不是证明虐待、判定责任或进行审问。护士应保持冷静，解释报告义务，客观记录，并维护安全。

byChoice.en: The correct trigger is reasonable suspicion and mandated reporting, not definitive proof, legal guilt, or caregiver permission.
byChoice.zh: 正确触发条件是合理怀疑和强制报告，而不是确凿证明、法律责任判定或照护者同意。

byChoice.en: The nurse should avoid confrontation and forensic interviewing; objective documentation and safety escalation remain appropriate.
byChoice.zh: 护士应避免对质和法医式访谈；客观记录和安全升级处理仍然合适。

testTakingStrategy.en: For legal/ethical nursing questions, identify the nurse's actual role: report reasonable suspicion, document facts, maintain safety, and leave investigation or guilt determination to the appropriate agencies.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 处理法律/伦理类护理题时，要明确护士的实际职责：报告合理怀疑、记录事实、维护安全，把调查或责任判定交给相应机构。

glossary.defZh: 法律要求特定专业人员在合理怀疑虐待或忽视时向指定机构报告。
由受过专门训练人员进行、用于保护调查完整性的正式访谈；不是普通护士的职责。
将患者或照护者的重要原话准确写入病历，避免主观解释。

stem.en: At Stage 3, the child is stable and a temporary safety plan is in place. Which nursing actions should be included in discharge planning and psychosocial support? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 第3阶段，患儿情况稳定，临时安全计划已建立。出院计划和心理社会支持应包括哪些护理行动？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Teach the mother the need for the follow-up skeletal survey in 2 weeks and orthopedic follow-up for the humeral fracture.
options.zh: 向母亲说明2周后复查骨骼系统筛查X线以及肱骨骨折骨科随访的必要性。

options.en: Give honest, supportive information that CPS's goal is child safety and reinforce the mother's protective actions.
options.zh: 诚实而支持性地说明CPS的目标是儿童安全，并强化母亲正在采取的保护性行动。

options.en: Limit discharge teaching to splint care because CPS is responsible for all safety and psychosocial issues.
options.zh: 将出院教育仅限于夹板护理，因为所有安全和心理社会问题都由CPS负责。

options.en: Document the mother's emotional state, her statements, and the child's behavioral responses to visitors.
options.zh: 记录母亲的情绪状态、她的陈述，以及患儿对访客的行为反应。

options.en: Coordinate with social work and CPS so community resources and the safety plan are confirmed before discharge.
options.zh: 与社工和CPS协调，确保出院前社区资源和安全计划已确认。

options.en: Reassure the mother that CPS will not remove the child as long as she cooperates with the plan.
options.zh: 安慰母亲：只要她配合计划，CPS就不会带走孩子。

correct.en: Discharge planning must address the medical injury, scheduled reevaluation for occult fractures, psychosocial support, objective documentation, and the safety plan. The nurse should support the mother without making promises about CPS decisions and should not narrow teaching to orthopedic care alone.
correct.zh: 出院计划必须涵盖医疗损伤、隐匿骨折复查、心理社会支持、客观记录和安全计划。护士应支持母亲，但不能承诺CPS的决定，也不能把教育只缩小到骨科护理。

byChoice.en: Focusing only on the splint ignores safety planning, psychosocial support, and required follow-up for occult injuries.
byChoice.zh: 只关注夹板护理会忽略安全计划、心理社会支持和隐匿损伤所需随访。

byChoice.en: Honest support reduces guilt and anxiety while keeping the focus on the child's safety and the mother's protective behavior.
byChoice.zh: 诚实支持可减轻内疚和焦虑，同时把重点放在儿童安全和母亲的保护性行为上。

byChoice.en: The nurse cannot promise what CPS will decide; over-reassurance is misleading and may damage trust.
byChoice.zh: 护士不能承诺CPS会作出什么决定；过度保证会误导家属并可能损害信任。

byChoice.en: The 2-week follow-up skeletal survey and orthopedic follow-up are explicit parts of the medical plan and must be understood before discharge.
byChoice.zh: 2周后复查骨骼系统筛查X线和骨科随访是医疗计划的明确组成部分，出院前必须让照护者理解。

byChoice.en: Safe discharge requires coordination with social work and CPS, not isolated bedside teaching.
byChoice.zh: 安全出院需要与社工和CPS协调，而不是只靠床旁教育。

byChoice.en: Objective documentation of caregiver statements and the child's behavioral responses supports continuity of care and safety monitoring.
byChoice.zh: 客观记录照护者陈述和患儿行为反应，有助于护理连续性和安全监测。

testTakingStrategy.en: For discharge after suspected abuse, think beyond the physical injury: safety plan, follow-up, resources, caregiver support, and objective documentation all matter.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 疑似虐待后的出院计划不能只看身体损伤：安全计划、随访、资源、照护者支持和客观记录都很重要。

glossary.defZh: 初始评估可能不明显、需影像或随访才发现的骨折。
限制特定人员接触或靠近受保护者的法律性保护措施。
由护理、医疗、社工和相关机构共同制定的出院安排。

correct.en: This case requires the nurse to integrate patterned bruising, injuries in different stages of healing, inconsistent caregiver explanations, caregiver behavior, and the child's responses to caregivers. The priority hypothesis is suspected nonaccidental trauma with a need for immediate safety actions, objective documentation, mandatory reporting through proper channels, pain and neurovascular care for the acute fracture, confidentiality-sensitive support for the mother, and coordinated discharge planning with CPS, social work, orthopedics, and the child abuse team. The nurse must not decide legal guilt, confront or interrogate the alleged perpetrator, or let reassuring findings such as a negative head CT erase the concern created by the overall injury pattern.
correct.zh: 本病例要求护士综合图案性瘀伤、不同愈合阶段的损伤、照护者解释不一致、照护者行为以及患儿对不同照护者的反应。优先判断是假设存在疑似非意外性创伤，需要立即采取安全行动、客观记录、通过正确渠道强制报告、为急性骨折提供疼痛和神经血管护理、以保护保密性的方式支持母亲，并与CPS、社工、骨科和儿童虐待团队协调出院计划。护士不应判定法律责任、对质或审问疑似施害者，也不应让头颅CT阴性等安慰性发现抵消整体损伤模式带来的疑虑。

testTakingStrategy.en: In unfolding child-safety cases, prioritize safety and reporting once reasonable suspicion is present, document objective facts, maintain clinical care for injuries, and stay within the nursing role rather than acting as an investigator.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 在儿童安全类展开病例中，一旦存在合理怀疑，应优先考虑安全和报告，客观记录事实，继续处理临床损伤，并保持在护理职责范围内，而不是充当调查人员。

glossary.defZh: 由照护者或他人蓄意造成或高度疑似蓄意造成的损伤模式，而非普通意外所能合理解释。
负责评估儿童安全、调查虐待或忽视疑虑并协调保护措施的机构。
基于临床资料和安全线索已足以触发报告义务的怀疑，不要求护士证明法律责任。
为降低儿童或家庭成员受伤风险而制定的具体监督、接触限制和支持安排。

stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items about safe discharge teaching for a limited-English-proficient patient with a new colostomy.
stem.zh: 阅读患者记录，并回答关于英语能力有限且新做结肠造口患者安全出院宣教的病例题。

title.en: Safe discharge teaching for a limited-English-proficient patient with a new colostomy
title.zh: 英语能力有限的新结肠造口患者安全出院宣教

summary.en: A 62-year-old Spanish-speaking woman is on postoperative day 3 after open sigmoid colectomy with end colostomy for perforated diverticulitis. She speaks and reads only Spanish. Her adult daughter speaks English and Spanish and has been interpreting at the bedside, but the chart contains no documentation of qualified interpreter use or patient teach-back. The surgeon's conditional discharge order requires the patient to demonstrate pouch emptying and wafer changing, identify concerning stoma findings, and explain when to call; caregiver participation may supplement but does not replace patient teach-back unless caregiver-dependent discharge planning is documented by the provider.
summary.zh: 一名62岁西班牙语患者因穿孔性憩室炎接受开放乙状结肠切除和末端结肠造口术后第3天。她只会说和读西班牙语。成年女儿会英语和西班牙语，并一直在床旁口译，但病历没有记录使用合格口译员，也没有记录患者本人回教。外科医生的有条件出院医嘱要求患者能演示造口袋排空和底盘更换、识别需担心的造口表现，并说明何时联系医生；照护者可参与补充，但除非医生记录为依赖照护者的出院计划，否则不能替代患者本人回教。

content.en:
Postoperative day 3 after open sigmoid colectomy with end colostomy.
History: type 2 diabetes; metformin 1,000 mg twice daily restarted this morning after adequate oral intake and creatinine 0.9 mg/dL; hypertension on lisinopril 10 mg daily; BMI 34.
Language: preferred language Spanish; speaks and reads only Spanish. No qualified interpreter use documented during admission.
Current orders: regular diet as tolerated; ambulate four times daily; saline lock; acetaminophen PRN; oxycodone PRN; wound and stoma assessments every shift; begin discharge planning today. WOC nurse consult placed postoperative day 1 but not completed.
Night note: 'Patient educated on ostomy care via daughter interpreting. Patient nodded understanding.' No teach-back documented.
Assessment: T 37.2 C, HR 78, BP 134/82, RR 16, SpO2 97% room air. Abdomen soft, mildly tender, no distension. Midline incision clean, dry, approximated with staples. Stoma round, beefy red, moist, about 3 cm diameter, protrudes about 1 cm. Two-piece cut-to-fit wafer with about 1/8-inch clearance. Pouch contains moderate thick greenish-brown stool. Peristomal skin intact. Pain 3/10 by fingers. Ambulates steadily to bathroom.
Labs: WBC 9.8 ×10³/µL; Hgb 11.4 g/dL; platelets 268 ×10³/µL; BUN 14 mg/dL; creatinine 0.9 mg/dL; K 4.0 mEq/L; Na 139 mEq/L; glucose 148 mg/dL; albumin 3.1 g/dL. No labs pending.
content.zh:
术后第3天，患者因穿孔性憩室炎接受开放乙状结肠切除和末端结肠造口。
病史：2型糖尿病；确认可经口进食且肌酐0.9 mg/dL后，今晨重新开始二甲双胍1,000 mg每日两次；高血压，服用赖诺普利10 mg每日一次；BMI 34。
语言：首选语言为西班牙语；只会说和读西班牙语。本次住院没有记录使用合格口译员。
当前医嘱：按耐受进普通饮食；每日下床活动4次；静脉留置盐水封管；对乙酰氨基酚按需；羟考酮按需；每班评估伤口和造口；今天开始出院计划。术后第1天已请造口伤口护理护士会诊，但尚未完成。
夜班记录：“通过女儿口译进行了造口护理宣教。患者点头表示理解。”未记录回教。
评估：T 37.2 C，HR 78，BP 134/82，RR 16，室内空气SpO2 97%。腹部软，切口周围轻度压痛，无腹胀。腹中线切口清洁、干燥，钉合良好。造口圆形、鲜红湿润，直径约3 cm，突出约1 cm。两件式可剪裁底盘，造口周围间隙约1/8英寸。造口袋内有中等量浓稠绿褐色粪便。造口周围皮肤完整。患者用手指表示疼痛3/10。可稳步走到卫生间。
实验室：WBC 9.8 ×10³/µL；Hgb 11.4 g/dL；血小板268 ×10³/µL；BUN 14 mg/dL；肌酐0.9 mg/dL；K 4.0 mEq/L；Na 139 mEq/L；血糖148 mg/dL；白蛋白3.1 g/dL。无待出结果。

content.en: The nurse identifies three gaps: no qualified interpreter has been used, no WOC nurse visit has occurred, and the discharge criteria require the patient's independent demonstration and explanation. The daughter offers to continue interpreting and states she will live with the patient after discharge. When the nurse asks the patient through the daughter to describe a normal stoma, the daughter answers, 'It should be red and wet,' and the patient nods. When asked directly in simple English with gestures to show pouch emptying, the patient looks to her daughter and the daughter begins guiding the patient's hands. The nurse requests a qualified Spanish interpreter, available by video within 15 minutes, and pages the WOC nurse, who can arrive by 1000.
content.zh: 护士发现三个缺口：没有使用合格口译员、造口伤口护理护士尚未会诊、出院标准要求患者本人独立演示并说明相关内容。女儿主动提出继续口译，并说出院后会与患者同住。护士通过女儿询问患者正常造口应是什么样，女儿回答：“应该是红色、湿的”，患者点头。护士用简单英语和手势直接请患者演示如何排空造口袋时，患者看向女儿，女儿开始引导患者的手。护士申请合格西班牙语口译员，视频口译15分钟内可用，并呼叫造口伤口护理护士，后者可在1000到达。

title.zh: 第2阶段：1000-1200 造口伤口护理护士宣教
口译协助下的造口宣教

content.en: The WOC nurse teaches with the qualified video interpreter. The patient asks new questions about showering, odor, and eating beans and rice. She says she has been afraid to look at the stoma and has let her daughter handle all pouch care. The WOC nurse supports a gradual first look, then guides independent pouch emptying; the patient performs it correctly on the second attempt. The patient removes the old wafer, inspects intact peristomal skin, cleans the area, and applies a new demonstration wafer with verbal coaching only. Output has increased: the pouch is emptied twice in two hours and output is thinner, yellow-green. Vitals: T 37.1 C, HR 74, BP 130/78, RR 14, SpO2 98%. Pain 2/10. Written ostomy instructions in Spanish and an insurance-compatible vendor list are provided. The nurse documents interpreter ID/language, teaching, return demonstration, and patient verbalization through the interpreter of three warning signs: stoma changes from red to dark purple or black, peristomal skin breakdown, and no output for more than 6 hours with cramping or distension.
content.zh: 造口伤口护理护士通过合格视频口译员进行宣教。患者提出新的问题：是否能淋浴、造口袋是否会有气味、是否能吃豆类和米饭。她说自己一直害怕看造口，并让女儿处理所有造口袋护理。造口伤口护理护士支持她循序渐进地第一次观察造口，然后指导她独立排空造口袋；患者第二次尝试时操作正确。患者取下旧底盘，检查完整的造口周围皮肤，清洁该区域，并仅在口头提示下贴上新的演示底盘。排出量增加：2小时内排空造口袋两次，排出物较稀、呈黄绿色。生命体征：T 37.1 C，HR 74，BP 130/78，RR 14，SpO2 98%。疼痛2/10。提供西班牙语书面造口护理说明和保险可接受的供应商清单。护士记录口译员编号/语言、宣教内容、回示演示，以及患者通过口译员说出的三个警示表现：造口由红色变成深紫色或黑色、造口周围皮肤破损、超过6小时无排出并伴腹部绞痛或腹胀。

content.en: The surgeon reviews the WOC documentation and confirms discharge criteria are met. Using the qualified interpreter, the nurse reviews medications, follow-up, diet, activity limits, when to call, and when to seek emergency care. Medications: metformin restarted; lisinopril continued; acetaminophen PRN; oxycodone prescription for five days with safe storage and disposal teaching. Follow-up: surgeon in 1 week; outpatient WOC nurse in 2 weeks. Diet: advance slowly, chew thoroughly, and introduce gas-producing foods one at a time. Activity: no lifting greater than 10 lb for 6 weeks per surgeon's order. The patient asks whether to check blood glucose at home. The nurse confirms the home glucometer is available and reviews the primary care provider's target fasting glucose range of 70-130 mg/dL. The daughter participates, but teach-back questions are directed to the patient through the interpreter. The patient correctly verbalizes warning signs, pouch emptying and changing, when to call, and the medication schedule. The nurse provides a 24-hour ostomy-support hotline and confirms two weeks of supplies. Discharge vitals: T 37.0 C, HR 76, BP 128/76, RR 14, SpO2 98%. Pain 1/10. Stoma remains red, moist, and functioning. Discharged home with daughter at 1445.
content.zh: 外科医生复核造口伤口护理护士记录，并确认已达到出院标准。护士通过合格口译员复习用药、随访、饮食、活动限制、何时联系医生以及何时急诊就医。用药：重新开始二甲双胍；继续赖诺普利；对乙酰氨基酚按需；羟考酮处方5天，并进行安全存放和处理宣教。随访：1周后外科医生复诊；2周后门诊造口伤口护理护士随访。饮食：逐步进食，充分咀嚼，一次只加入一种产气食物。活动：按外科医嘱6周内不得提举超过10磅。患者询问回家后是否测血糖。护士确认家中有血糖仪，并复习基层医生既有指示的空腹血糖目标范围70-130 mg/dL。女儿参与，但回教问题均通过口译员直接问患者。患者正确说出警示表现、造口袋排空和更换、何时联系医生以及用药时间表。护士提供24小时造口支持热线，并确认有两周用品。出院生命体征：T 37.0 C，HR 76，BP 128/76，RR 14，SpO2 98%。疼痛1/10。造口仍红润、湿润且有功能。1445与女儿一起出院回家。

stem.en: Stage 1: The daughter offers to interpret the ostomy discharge teaching. The chart shows no prior qualified interpreter use, no WOC nurse note, and no documented teach-back. What should the nurse do first?
stem.zh: 第1阶段：患者女儿主动提出为造口出院宣教做口译。病历显示此前没有使用合格口译员、没有造口伤口护理护士记录，也没有记录回教法。护士首先应怎么做？

options.en: Proceed with teaching through the daughter because she is bilingual and will live with the patient.
options.zh: 通过女儿继续宣教，因为她会说两种语言并将与患者同住。

options.en: Ask the daughter to sign the discharge instructions because she has been doing the pouch care.
options.zh: 让女儿签署出院说明，因为一直是她在照护造口袋。

options.en: Give the Spanish written instructions and document that written teaching was provided.
options.zh: 提供西班牙语书面说明，并记录已给予书面宣教。

options.en: Arrange a qualified Spanish medical interpreter before formal discharge teaching and keep the daughter present for support if the patient wants.
options.zh: 在正式出院宣教前安排合格的西班牙语医疗口译员；若患者愿意，可让女儿在场提供支持。

correct.en: Formal discharge teaching for a patient with limited English proficiency requires direct communication with the patient through qualified language assistance. The daughter may support the patient, but the case cues show she has been answering for the patient and guiding the skill rather than confirming the patient's own understanding.
correct.zh: 英语能力有限患者的正式出院宣教需要通过合格语言协助直接与患者沟通。女儿可以支持患者，但病例线索显示她一直代替患者回答并指导操作，而不是确认患者本人的理解。

byChoice.en: Written materials help reinforce teaching but do not replace interpreted discussion, teach-back, or return demonstration.
byChoice.zh: 书面材料可强化宣教，但不能替代通过口译进行的讨论、回教法和回示演示。

byChoice.en: The conditional discharge order requires the patient's demonstration and verbalization unless caregiver-dependent discharge planning is specifically documented by the provider.
byChoice.zh: 有条件出院医嘱要求患者本人演示和表述，除非医嘱明确记录为依赖照护者的出院计划。

byChoice.en: This action protects language access, preserves the patient's autonomy, and allows valid assessment of the patient's own understanding and skill.
byChoice.zh: 这一做法保障语言服务，维护患者自主权，并能有效评估患者本人是否理解并掌握技能。

byChoice.en: A willing bilingual family member is not adequate here because the daughter has been answering for the patient and the clinical stakes require accurate, patient-centered teach-back.
byChoice.zh: 在本病例中，愿意帮忙且会双语的家属不足以承担正式口译，因为女儿一直代替患者回答，而且该宣教需要准确、以患者为中心的回教确认。

testTakingStrategy.en: When a patient has limited English proficiency, do not equate family support with qualified interpretation. Ask who is demonstrating understanding: the patient or someone speaking for the patient.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 遇到英语能力有限的患者时，不要把家属支持等同于合格口译。要判断是谁在表现理解：是患者本人，还是代替患者说话的人。

glossary.defZh: 患者不能充分使用英语理解、表达或阅读医疗信息，需要合格的语言协助。
受过医疗口译训练、能准确传达医疗信息并遵守保密要求的人员。
让患者用自己的话复述或演示护理内容，以确认真正理解。

stem.en: Stage 1: Which findings show that the patient has not yet met the surgeon's discharge criteria? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 第1阶段：哪些发现表明患者尚未达到外科医生规定的出院标准？选择所有适用项。

options.en: The daughter answers the normal-stoma question for the patient.
options.zh: 女儿代替患者回答正常造口表现的问题。

options.en: The only documented education was done through the daughter, with no qualified interpreter documented.
options.zh: 唯一记录的宣教是通过女儿完成，且没有记录合格口译员。

options.en: The patient nods and says brief English words that do not clearly match the questions.
options.zh: 患者点头并说简短英语词语，但这些反应与问题内容不明确匹配。

options.en: The daughter begins guiding the patient's hands during the pouch-emptying demonstration.
options.zh: 在造口袋排空演示时，女儿开始引导患者的双手。

options.en: The stoma is beefy red, moist, and protrudes about 1 cm above the skin.
options.zh: 造口呈鲜红湿润，突出皮肤约1厘米。

options.en: The patient is afebrile, hemodynamically stable, and ambulatory to the bathroom.
options.zh: 患者无发热，血流动力学稳定，并能步行至卫生间。

correct.en: The discharge order requires the patient's own demonstration of pouch emptying and wafer changing, identification of concerning stoma findings, and explanation of when to call. Lack of qualified interpreter use, unclear acquiescent responses, family-member answering, and hands-on guidance all prevent the nurse from confirming that the patient herself meets those criteria.
correct.zh: 出院医嘱要求患者本人演示造口袋排空和底盘更换、识别需担心的造口表现，并说明何时联系医生。未使用合格口译、反应含糊的附和、家属代答以及手把手引导，都使护士无法确认患者本人已达到这些标准。

byChoice.en: No qualified interpreter documentation means the nurse cannot verify language-concordant discharge teaching or the patient's own teach-back.
byChoice.zh: 没有合格口译员记录，说明护士无法确认已进行语言相符的出院宣教，也无法确认患者本人的回教结果。

byChoice.en: A red, moist, protruding stoma is an expected finding and does not show failure to meet teaching criteria.
byChoice.zh: 造口红润、湿润并突出是预期表现，并不说明宣教标准未达成。

byChoice.en: Nodding or saying 'yes' in a non-primary language is not reliable evidence of comprehension.
byChoice.zh: 用非主要语言点头或说“是”并不是可靠的理解证据。

byChoice.en: The daughter's answer is not the patient's verbalization, so it does not satisfy the stated discharge criterion.
byChoice.zh: 女儿的回答不是患者本人的表述，因此不满足医嘱中的出院标准。

byChoice.en: Stable vital signs and ambulation support physiologic readiness, but they do not prove ostomy self-care teaching criteria are met.
byChoice.zh: 生命体征稳定和能下床活动支持生理层面的出院准备，但不能证明造口自我护理宣教标准已达成。

byChoice.en: Guiding the patient's hands means independent return demonstration has not yet occurred.
byChoice.zh: 引导患者双手说明尚未完成独立的回示演示。

testTakingStrategy.en: For discharge-readiness items, separate physiologic stability from required teaching criteria. Stable vitals do not replace a required patient return demonstration.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 做出院准备题时，要区分生理稳定与规定的宣教标准。生命体征稳定不能替代患者必须完成的回示演示。

glossary.defZh: 让患者用自己的话复述或演示护理内容，以确认真正理解。
患者亲自完成一项技能，以证明已能安全执行。
患者出院前必须满足的医嘱、护理和安全条件。

stem.en: Stage 2: Using the qualified interpreter, the patient says she has been afraid to look at the stoma and has allowed her daughter to handle all pouch care. What is the priority nursing response before continuing skill teaching?
stem.zh: 第2阶段：通过合格口译员，患者表示她一直害怕看造口，并让女儿处理所有造口袋护理。继续技能宣教前，护士优先应如何回应？

options.en: Ask the daughter to complete the wafer change while the patient watches from bed.
options.zh: 请女儿完成底盘更换，患者在床上观看即可。

options.en: Tell the patient that the stoma looks healthy and move directly to the return demonstration.
options.zh: 告诉患者造口看起来健康，然后直接进入回示演示。

options.en: Acknowledge the fear, invite the patient to describe her concerns, and guide a gradual first look at the stoma with interpreter support.
options.zh: 承认患者的害怕感受，请她描述担忧，并在口译员协助下循序渐进地第一次观察造口。

options.en: Postpone all teaching until the outpatient WOC visit in two weeks.
options.zh: 把所有宣教推迟到两周后的门诊造口护理随访。

correct.en: The patient's avoidance is a psychosocial barrier to self-care. Brief supportive counseling and a gradual, interpreter-facilitated first look address readiness so the later pouch-emptying and wafer-change teaching can be effective.
correct.zh: 患者回避造口是自我护理的心理社会障碍。简短支持性沟通和在口译员协助下循序渐进观察造口，有助于建立准备度，使后续排空造口袋和更换底盘的教学有效。

byChoice.en: This response addresses the emotional barrier while preserving the goal of patient self-management.
byChoice.zh: 这一回应处理了情绪障碍，同时保留患者自我管理的目标。

byChoice.en: Outpatient follow-up is important, but delaying all teaching would leave the patient unprepared for immediate home care.
byChoice.zh: 门诊随访重要，但推迟所有宣教会使患者对回家后的即时护理没有准备。

byChoice.en: Having the daughter do the care reinforces dependence and does not address the patient's fear or required independent skill.
byChoice.zh: 让女儿操作会强化依赖，不能处理患者恐惧，也不能满足患者独立掌握技能的要求。

byChoice.en: Reassurance alone skips the patient's expressed fear and may worsen avoidance during the skill demonstration.
byChoice.zh: 单纯安慰跳过了患者表达的恐惧，可能在技能演示时加重回避。

testTakingStrategy.en: When a patient avoids a new body change, address readiness and coping before expecting independent technical performance.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当患者回避新的身体改变时，应先处理准备度和应对，再要求其独立完成技术操作。

glossary.defZh: 患者在情绪、认知和支持系统方面准备好参与护理的程度。
个人对自己身体外观和功能的感受与看法。
将结肠开口引至腹壁，使粪便经造口排出。

stem.en: Stage 2: Classify each colostomy finding as expected for this patient's current postoperative course or requiring follow-up/escalation.
stem.zh: 第2阶段：判断每个结肠造口相关发现对该患者当前术后过程而言是预期表现，还是需要跟进/升级处理。

rows.en: Stoma is beefy red and moist.
rows.zh: 造口鲜红且湿润。

rows.en: Peristomal skin remains intact without redness or breakdown.
rows.zh: 造口周围皮肤完整，无发红或破损。

rows.en: Output is thinner and more yellow-green, and the pouch was emptied twice in two hours; vital signs are stable.
rows.zh: 排出物变稀、偏黄绿色，2小时内排空造口袋两次；生命体征稳定。

rows.en: Stoma becomes dark purple or black.
rows.zh: 造口变成深紫色或黑色。

rows.en: No stoma output for more than 6 hours with cramping or abdominal distension.
rows.zh: 超过6小时无造口排出，并伴腹部绞痛或腹胀。

rows.en: Peristomal skin develops redness and breakdown.
rows.zh: 造口周围皮肤出现发红和破损。

correct.en: The patient's red, moist stoma, intact peristomal skin, stable vital signs, and looser early postoperative output are appropriate for continued monitoring. Color change to dark purple or black, absent output with cramping or distension, or skin breakdown are warning signs that require follow-up.
correct.zh: 患者造口红润湿润、造口周围皮肤完整、生命体征稳定，以及术后早期排出物较稀，均适合继续常规观察。造口变深紫或黑色、无排出伴绞痛或腹胀、皮肤破损则是需要跟进的警示表现。

byChoice.en: A beefy red, moist stoma indicates perfused tissue in this case.
byChoice.zh: 鲜红湿润的造口提示该病例中造口组织灌注良好。

byChoice.en: Intact peristomal skin is an expected protective finding.
byChoice.zh: 造口周围皮肤完整是预期的保护性发现。

byChoice.en: Early postoperative output may become looser as bowel function returns; stable vital signs and diet tolerance support routine monitoring.
byChoice.zh: 肠功能恢复时，术后早期排出物可变稀；生命体征稳定且能进食支持常规观察。

byChoice.en: Dark purple or black color suggests impaired perfusion and requires prompt follow-up.
byChoice.zh: 深紫色或黑色提示灌注受损，需要及时跟进。

byChoice.en: Absent output with cramping or distension can indicate obstruction or another complication and requires follow-up.
byChoice.zh: 无排出并伴绞痛或腹胀可能提示梗阻或其他并发症，需要跟进。

byChoice.en: Peristomal redness and breakdown can impair pouch adherence and increase skin-injury risk.
byChoice.zh: 造口周围发红和破损会影响造口袋粘贴并增加皮肤损伤风险。

testTakingStrategy.en: Compare the finding with the whole trend. Stable vitals and functioning output make a mild output change less concerning, but color change, no output with symptoms, or skin breakdown are red flags.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 将单个发现放到整体趋势中判断。生命体征稳定且造口有功能时，轻度排出物变化较不令人担心；但颜色改变、无排出伴症状或皮肤破损是危险信号。

glossary.defZh: 造口周围与底盘和造口袋接触的皮肤区域。
造口组织血流不足，可能出现暗紫色或黑色改变。
腹部膨隆或胀满，可提示气体、液体或梗阻相关问题。

stem.en: Stage 3: During medication reconciliation, the patient asks whether she should check blood glucose at home now that metformin has been restarted. Complete the nurse's response.
stem.zh: 第3阶段：用药核对时，患者询问现在已重新开始服用二甲双胍，回家后是否应监测血糖。完成护士的回应。

clozeStem.en: The nurse should first {{1}} and teach that metformin used alone has a {{2}}.
clozeStem.zh: 护士应首先 {{1}}，并说明单独使用二甲双胍时 {{2}}。

options.en: tell the daughter to monitor and report the glucose values instead of asking the patient
options.zh: 告诉女儿代替患者监测并报告血糖值

options.en: confirm the patient's existing home glucose-monitoring plan and supplies
options.zh: 确认患者原有的家庭血糖监测计划和用品是否齐备

options.en: instruct the patient to stop home monitoring because creatinine is normal
options.zh: 因为肌酐正常，指导患者停止家庭血糖监测

options.en: low risk of hypoglycemia compared with insulin or insulin secretagogues
options.zh: 与胰岛素或促胰岛素分泌药相比，低血糖风险较低

options.en: high risk of sudden hypoglycemia that requires juice at the bedside
options.zh: 突然低血糖风险很高，需要在床边备果汁

options.en: requirement to hold lisinopril whenever fasting glucose is above target
options.zh: 只要空腹血糖高于目标值就必须停用赖诺普利

correct.en: The nurse can reinforce the patient's existing diabetes plan by confirming that the glucometer and supplies are available and reviewing the provider's target range. Metformin alone is not primarily associated with hypoglycemia; the teaching should not overstate low-glucose risk or shift responsibility away from the patient.
correct.zh: 护士可以通过确认血糖仪和耗材是否可用，并复习医嘱中的目标范围来强化患者既有糖尿病管理计划。单独使用二甲双胍通常不是低血糖的主要原因；宣教不应夸大低血糖风险，也不应把责任从患者本人转移走。

byChoice.en: The first dropdown is correct when it keeps teaching within the existing diabetes management plan and verifies the patient has supplies for home monitoring.
byChoice.zh: 第一个下拉项正确之处在于，它把宣教限定在患者既有糖尿病管理计划内，并确认患者有家庭监测用品。

byChoice.en: The second dropdown is correct when it avoids overstating hypoglycemia risk from metformin monotherapy and distinguishes metformin from insulin or insulin secretagogues.
byChoice.zh: 第二个下拉项正确之处在于，它没有夸大二甲双胍单药治疗导致低血糖的风险，并将其与胰岛素或促胰岛素分泌药区分开。

testTakingStrategy.en: Medication-reconciliation teaching should reinforce the current plan and correct the specific misconception. Do not add unrelated hold parameters or delegate the patient's self-management without need.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 用药核对宣教应强化现有计划，并纠正具体误解。不要添加无关的停药参数，也不要无必要地把患者自我管理交给他人。

glossary.defZh: 常用于2型糖尿病的口服降糖药，主要改善胰岛素敏感性并减少肝糖输出。
血糖低于目标范围，可能出现出汗、颤抖、心悸、意识改变等表现。
核对住院前、住院中和出院后用药，确保医嘱准确一致。

stem.en: Stage 3: Which findings best support that discharge teaching has been effective and that the patient is safe to go home? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 第3阶段：哪些发现最能支持出院宣教有效，且患者可以安全回家？选择所有适用项。

options.en: The nurse documents interpreter use, return demonstration, teach-back responses, supplies, and follow-up arrangements.
options.zh: 护士记录口译员使用、回示演示、回教回答、用品和随访安排。

options.en: The patient completed pouch emptying and wafer application with verbal coaching only during the WOC session.
options.zh: 在造口伤口护理护士教学中，患者仅在口头提示下完成造口袋排空和底盘粘贴。

options.en: The patient verbalizes the medication schedule and follow-up plan through the interpreter.
options.zh: 患者通过口译员说出用药时间表和随访计划。

options.en: The daughter says she understands the instructions and will take care of the pouch at home.
options.zh: 女儿说她理解说明，并会在家照顾造口袋。

options.en: Through the interpreter, the patient states the stoma warning signs in her own words.
options.zh: 通过口译员，患者用自己的话说出造口警示表现。

options.en: The patient receives written ostomy instructions in Spanish and a supply/vendor plan.
options.zh: 患者获得西班牙语书面造口护理说明以及用品/供应商计划。

correct.en: Effective discharge evaluation combines patient-centered teach-back through a qualified interpreter, return demonstration of psychomotor skills, written language-concordant reinforcement, supplies, follow-up, and complete documentation. The daughter's understanding is helpful support but does not by itself prove the patient's readiness under the stated discharge criteria.
correct.zh: 有效的出院评估应结合通过合格口译员完成的以患者为中心的回教、心理运动技能回示演示、语言相符的书面强化、用品、随访以及完整记录。女儿理解说明可作为支持，但根据本病例出院标准，单靠女儿理解不能证明患者本人已准备好。

byChoice.en: Return demonstration with only verbal coaching shows the patient can perform the needed pouching skills without hands-on family assistance.
byChoice.zh: 仅需口头提示即可回示演示，说明患者能在没有家属手把手帮助的情况下完成所需造口袋技能。

byChoice.en: Documentation of interpreter use, teach-back, return demonstration, supplies, and follow-up closes the safety and communication loop.
byChoice.zh: 记录口译、回教、回示演示、用品和随访，完成了安全与沟通闭环。

byChoice.en: Written Spanish instructions and a supply plan reduce home-care barriers and reinforce verbal teaching.
byChoice.zh: 西班牙语书面说明和用品计划可降低居家护理障碍，并强化口头宣教。

byChoice.en: The patient's own explanation through an interpreter directly evaluates comprehension of warning signs.
byChoice.zh: 患者本人通过口译员说明警示表现，直接评估了她的理解。

byChoice.en: Caregiver understanding is supportive, but it does not replace the patient's own teach-back unless caregiver-dependent discharge planning is specifically documented.
byChoice.zh: 照护者理解有帮助，但除非明确记录依赖照护者的出院计划，否则不能替代患者本人的回教。

byChoice.en: The patient's own verbalization of medications and follow-up confirms broader discharge understanding beyond ostomy technique.
byChoice.zh: 患者本人说出用药和随访安排，确认了除造口技术外更全面的出院理解。

testTakingStrategy.en: For evaluation questions, look for objective evidence that the learner or patient actually performed or explained the required skill, not just that teaching was delivered.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 做评估题时，要寻找学习者或患者确实完成或说明所需技能的客观证据，而不仅是“已经宣教”。

glossary.defZh: 让患者用自己的话复述或演示护理内容，以确认真正理解。
患者亲自完成一项技能，以证明已能安全执行。
以患者能阅读和理解的语言提供的教育资料。

correct.en: This case turns on distinguishing apparent family-supported discharge readiness from verified patient readiness. The priority cues are limited English proficiency, lack of qualified interpreter documentation, no WOC teaching, no patient teach-back, and daughter-directed answers and hand guidance. Safe care requires qualified interpreter use, WOC-led teaching, attention to the patient's fear of viewing the stoma, return demonstration, warning-sign teach-back, medication reconciliation within the existing diabetes plan, adequate supplies, follow-up, and complete documentation. The patient becomes discharge-ready only after she personally demonstrates pouch care and explains warning signs and the home plan through the interpreter.
correct.zh: 本病例的核心是区分“看似有家属支持的出院准备”与“已验证的患者本人出院准备”。关键线索包括英语能力有限、无合格口译记录、无造口伤口护理护士宣教、无患者本人回教，以及女儿代答和手把手引导。安全护理需要使用合格口译员、由造口伤口护理护士进行宣教、处理患者害怕看造口的情绪、完成回示演示、回教警示表现、在既有糖尿病计划内进行用药核对、确认用品和随访，并完整记录。只有当患者本人通过口译员演示造口袋护理并说明警示表现和居家计划后，才达到出院准备。

testTakingStrategy.en: In unfolding discharge cases, track the exact criteria that must be met before discharge and evaluate whether the patient, not only the caregiver, has demonstrated comprehension and skill.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 在展开式出院病例中，要追踪出院前必须达到的具体标准，并评估患者本人而不仅是照护者是否已展示理解和技能。

glossary.defZh: 患者不能充分使用英语理解、表达或阅读医疗信息，需要合格的语言协助。
受过医疗口译训练、能准确传达医疗信息并遵守保密要求的人员。
让患者用自己的话复述或演示护理内容，以确认真正理解。
患者亲自完成一项技能，以证明已能安全执行。
将结肠开口引至腹壁，使粪便经造口排出。
